High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Jabalpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard on I.A.No.19517/2025, an application for condonation of delay in filing the present revision.
Looking to the reasons assigned therein, the application is allowed and the delay in filing the present revision is hereby condoned.
Revision is admitted for final hearing.
Records of the Court below have been received.
The petitioners have filed I.A. No.19155/2025, an application under Section 438 of BNSS of 2023 for suspension of sentence and grant of bail.

The petitioners were convicted vide judgment dated 17.12.2024 passed by Judicial Magistrate First Class, Ajaygarh District Panna in RCT No.376/2023 for the offence punishable under Section 457 of IPC and sentenced to RI for three years with fine of Rs.1000/-, each and under Section 380 of IPC and sentenced to RI for two years with fine of Rs.1000/- each, with default stipulation, which is affirmed by the Appellate Court vide judgment dated 13.03.2025 passed by the Second Additional Sessions Judge, Panna District Panna (M.P.) in Criminal Appeal No.08/2025.

entities.text: Judicial Magistrate First Class, Ajaygarh District Panna
entities.label: COURT

entities.text: Second Additional Sessions Judge, Panna District Panna
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
The petitioners are in jail since 14.7.2025.
2 CRR-3805-2025
Considering the criminal record of petitioner No.1 Halkey @ Ramdeen, his application (I.A. No.19155/2025) is rejected.

So far as application of petitioner No.2-Devanand is concerned, considering his custody period, and the fact that final hearing of this revision may take time, without expressing any opinion on merits of the case, I deem it proper to suspend the jail sentence of the petitioner No.2.
It is directed that execution of jail sentence of the petitioner No.2- Devanand is hereby suspended.

It is directed that the petitioner No.2 be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond for a sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the Halkey @ Ramdeen vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 8 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/139236460/
